mapper.select: WITH TARGET_INFO AS ( SELECT T.TARGET_TYPE_CD, T.TARGET_ID, T.SCHD_ID, E.EMP_NM, E.DEPT_CD, E.JOB_GRD_CD, E.PRFL_IMG_FILE_ID FROM TB_SCHD_TARGET T LEFT JOIN TB_EMPLOYEE E ON T.TARGET_TYPE_CD = '02' AND T.TARGET_ID = TO_CHAR(E.EMP_ID) WHERE T.SCHD_ID = #{schdId} ) SELECT TI.TARGET_TYPE_CD, TI.TARGET_ID, CASE TI.TARGET_TYPE_CD WHEN '02' THEN TI.EMP_NM WHEN '04' THEN D.DEPT_NM WHEN '05' THEN P.PROJ_NM WHEN '06' THEN TK.TASK_NM END AS TARGET_NM, D.DEPT_NM, G.JOB_GRD_NM, F.SAVE_PATH_NM || '/' || F.SAVE_FILE_NM AS PROFILE_IMG_URL FROM TARGET_INFO TI LEFT JOIN TB_DEPARTMENT D ON (TI.TARGET_TYPE_CD = '02' AND TI.DEPT_CD = D.DEPT_CD) OR (TI.TARGET_TYPE_CD = '04' AND TI.TARGET_ID = D.DEPT_CD) LEFT JOIN TB_JOB_GRADE G ON TI.JOB_GRD_CD = G.JOB_GRD_CD LEFT JOIN TB_CMMN_ATCH_FILE_CLSF FC ON TI.PRFL_IMG_FILE_ID = FC.ATCH_FILE_ID LEFT JOIN TB_CMMN_ATCH_FILE_DTL F ON FC.ATCH_FILE_ID = F.ATCH_FILE_ID AND F.DEL_YN = 'N' LEFT JOIN TB_PROJECT P ON TI.TARGET_TYPE_CD = '05' AND TI.TARGET_ID = TO_CHAR(P.PROJ_ID) LEFT JOIN TB_TASK TK ON TI.TARGET_TYPE_CD = '06' AND TI.TARGET_ID = TO_CHAR(TK.TASK_ID) ORDER BY TI.TARGET_TYPE_CD ASC, TI.TARGET_ID ASC
